config.description: Dashboard chips (and later room remotes) call this to force a block in an area. Records the override in sensor.ls_overrides with who/when/via. Choosing the block the schedule already has right now ends the override instead. House (Common Areas) also applies to every room scope whose area lacks the label Private Room.

scope.name: Area
scope.description: house, or the area id of any room with scheduled lamps

variables.targets: {{ [scope] + (((label_entities('house_schedule') + label_entities('on_off') + ((label_devices('house_schedule') + label_devices('on_off')) | map('device_entities') | sum(start=[]))) | map('area_id') | select | unique | reject('in', label_areas('private_room')) | list) if scope == 'house' else []) }}
variables.set_recs: {%- set ns = namespace(r=[]) -%}{%- for t in targets if sched.get(t) != b -%}{%- set ns.r = ns.r + [{'kind': 'block', 'target': t, 'value': b}] -%}{%- endfor -%}{{ ns.r }}
variables.clear_keys: {%- set ns = namespace(k=[]) -%}{%- for t in targets if sched.get(t) == b -%}{%- set ns.k = ns.k + ['block:' ~ t] -%}{%- endfor -%}{{ ns.k }}
